(I)--a son of Rucaka (पुरवृत्-वि। प्।) banished out of the land by his elder brothers who were kings; surrounded by Brahmans he lived in a fearful forest in peace; soon he set out with a chariot and a flag towards the kingdom on the नर्मदा single-handed and reached the hill ऋक्षवान्; his wife was Saivya, but they had no son. In the battle he won victory, and soon got a daughter, whom he called श्नुषा, (daughter- in-law) adding to his wife that the son to be born would be her husband; the son was वैश, the Vidarbha, who married स्नुषा, and got two sons, Kratha and कौशिक;
1: भा. IX. २३. ३५-39. Br.
